title: Grateful Dead Live at Tivolis Koncertsal on 1972-04-17
source: SBD>16 track 2" MR>DAT4x>Delta Dio 2496>Soundforge>WAV>Cd Wave Editor>Flac

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a solid Europe ’72 show with standout China Cat > Rider, first‑ever He's Gone, blistering Big Railroad Blues and a peaceful Dark Star.
ai_review.review: The recording is a clean, high‑fidelity soundboard source that lets the nuances of this April 17, 1972 Tivoli performance shine. Fans rave about the energetic China Cat Sunflower → I Know You Rider, the historic debut of He's Gone, a scorching Big Railroad Blues (complete with the Bozo‑mask TV moment), and a uniquely mellow Dark Star to close the third set. Overall the show is praised as one of the finer moments of the Europe ’72 tour.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently high star ratings (5, 4, 5) and enthusiastic comments highlight both a strong musical performance and excellent soundboard quality.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Reviewers describe the sound as crystal‑clear and note no significant dropouts or balance issues; the recording captures the band’s dynamics very well.

standout_songs: China Cat Sunflower > I Know You Rider
show_quality.setlist_flow: The show builds smoothly through two strong sets and a third‑set Dark Star that offers a calm, reflective contrast to the high‑energy first half.

band_member_comments.Phil: Praised for his 'smokin'' bass line during It Hurts Me Too and overall solid playing; highlighted as a memorable moment with him smoking a joint on camera.
